name: Lucide
summary: Open-source icon library with 1600+ SVG icons, shipped as official packages for React, Vue, Svelte, Angular and more.
description: Lucide is an open-source icon library that provides 1600+ SVG files for digital and non-digital projects, a fork of Feather Icons. Icons ship through official packages (lucide, lucide-react, @lucide/vue, @lucide/svelte, lucide-solid, lucide-preact, lucide-react-native, @lucide/angular, @lucide/astro, lucide-static) plus a Figma plugin. Free for commercial and personal use under the ISC license.
contains: official packages for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact, Angular, Astro and React Native
ISC license, free for commercial and personal use
